AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 46 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7698, #7700, #7702, #7707 and #7708. All five are merged PRs and now carry the read-back `audit:complete` label:

- #7698 → #7694: surrogate-pair-safe action truncation with boundary regression tests.
- #7700 → #6014: dated OCapN/CapTP watch, explicit spike trigger and research-pass cadence.
- #7702 → #6474: duplicate JSON fields rejected in fixture headers/events.
- #7707 → #6057: staging-shard ingest-gate design record.
- #7708 → #5973: world-governance design record; clarification PR #7888 merged and issue is closed complete.

The five PR bodies, diffs, comments, linked issue bodies/comments, verdicts and label readbacks are recorded in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7698-7708/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7698-7708.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 46 valid PRs audited from 50 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 200 identifiers remain, next #7710. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
